author: John Hammond
description:
We got a Canary Token triggered, and that got me thinking about what happens when you give AI the ability to work with a cyber deception setup.

Messing around with Canarytokens and Mailhooks on a live stream, we started exploring what it could look like to let AI interact with the alerting dashboard.

Watch the full video: https://youtu.be/kK145Pywm9E?si=-v8YBp04tL96Kg
title: Canary Tokens, Meet AI
